author: Kai Moreno
title: ISO 27001 certification pack for Redwood (vendor review)
content:
# Purpose
Procurement teams at our customers often ask for Redwood's ISO 27001 certificate and statement of applicability. This page is that vendor-review pack. It is not a request to place the customer's records in their cloud.

# When to use
The writer is a procurement or GRC person asking whether Redwood is ISO 27001 certified, asking for the certificate PDF, or asking us to fill Redwood's column on their vendor spreadsheet.

# When not to use
If they want their own records sitting in a bucket they own before their people arrive on site, this is the wrong page. Stop. That is a customer-managed export, not a vendor pack.

# Priority and routing
ISO vendor packs are priority P3 and assigned to Legal. Add the label vendor-iso. Do not assign Eng Infra or Eng Platform. Do not page anyone.

# What Legal sends
The current ISO 27001 certificate, the statement of applicability summary, and the public subprocessor list. We do not fill free-form spreadsheets that ask for employee home addresses or production IPs.

# Deadlines
A customer's on-site visit is not a reason to raise this ticket. The certificate already exists. Legal sends it in the normal P3 queue.

# Customer reply
Redwood is ISO 27001 certified. Legal will send the certificate. If you need your own Redwood records in your cloud, say that clearly and we will open a different request.

# Related
SOC 2 evidence pack. Vendor questionnaire pages. Not the customer-managed export SOP.
